$Comment: Grandmaster: the title the achievement mastery_trainer_tier_3 pays once a player reaches Grandmaster with the Mastery Trainer. It shows beside a player's name in menus and leaderboards once they pick it. Its name, its flavor and where it sits around the name are the keys title.mmo_mastery_grandmaster.name, .flavor and .display (whose {0} is the name). Order sorts it in the title picker; Enabled false hides it everywhere without taking it from anybody who earned it.
